content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, letting my breath brush his skin ||| "Can they hear how much I want you?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, releasing the blade from my grip ||| "I can’t answer until we understand the truth."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, letting my guard drop ||| "I can’t stop thinking about what you said."  
REVERSAL ||| Take a bold step forward, reclaiming the moment ||| "I’ll speak, but only if you promise to listen."  
SILENCE ||| Close my eyes, grounding myself in the weight of the room ||| *A breath, heavy and laden with meaning.*
